context:
Goal: the merge tool backs off when the GitHub quota runs low, and never merges under a running batch.
Problem (risk): round 4 closed the defect you granted (780 c) but found the same kind again: a low-quota reply on the batch-brake check can hold the merge call for up to 900 s after that check. A batch PR marked ready in that window is missed, and the lane would merge under a running batch. Your grant covered one defect only.
Based on (measured): the reviewer's probe, per the lane (unchecked by triage): with the pulls list low it paused 600 s, then read the PR, then the merge call landed.
Departs from: main — main sends the merge call right after the brake check; this branch can wait first. a changes the branch again, b leaves main as it is, c changes nothing.
Meanwhile: the lane waits and does nothing more.
